summary: A pinned media panel on the left changes its figure and caption as each step on the right scrolls through the middle of the frame; the step in view has the primary title colour, the others the secondary one.
use: Explaining a product flow: connect, sort, review. One visual stays on screen while the copy advances.
spec: `MotionStage` from `@codeatlasdev/ui` with `loop={5600}`: autoplay scrolls the container, a wheel or touch scroll takes over
`.story__media` is `position: sticky;` with `inset-block-start: 0;` and pins the media while the steps list scrolls past
`IntersectionObserver` with `rootMargin: '-45% 0px -45% 0px'` makes the step crossing the middle 10% band the active one
Figure transition: `opacity 320ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)` and a `translateY(12px) scale(0.96)` start state
The active step title is `var(--ca-text-primary)`, the others `var(--ca-text-secondary)` (a colour change, never a lower opacity, so every state stays AA)
Under reduced motion the last step is active and nothing scrolls by itself
